name: apps.mijia.scene.selected_index
evidence: The Mi Home scene page stores its root at 0x2010ff20 during creation and clears it on destruction. Row creation and updates register click event 7 with the list index as user data. The shared callback reads it, compares it to the scene count at scene_list + 8 with a signed GE condition, calculates the entry address from the list base plus index * 32, and dispatches scene handling unless a prior scene is already executing.
scope: scene index read on a Mi Home scene-list click while its page root is active
limitations: Changing the index can execute a different real-world scene. The module must preserve a nonnegative index below the current count; firmware uses a signed upper-bound check and a negative value can point before the list. Do not treat an out-of-range value as a safe way to suppress execution. The underlying getter is shared system-wide and requires quiescence during publication and rollback.
registration_evidence: Both branches of row creation and row update register the scene click callback; event code 7 and user data index are passed. These four caller paths ignore the returned descriptor.
